summary: FreeCast, Inc. disclosed on Form 8-K that it entered into a Renewal Revolving Convertible Promissory Note with Nextelligence, Inc., controlled by its CEO and majority shareholder, renewing a prior $5 million note. The note allows conversion into Class A common stock at the prior trading day's closing price. An immediate conversion of $1,712,052 principal into 484,354 shares occurred. The filing records a related-party financing and conversion, not a transformative event. The conversion price of $3.51 and $4.00 per share was set. This is an insider funding arrangement with no broad tender or liquidity event. Watch for dilution from further conversions.
